name: opportunity-scout-memory-eval
description: Deterministic local eval pack for HandoffBase AI Opportunity Scout memory behavior.

cases.description: Recall user preference for credentials, founder network, and startup resources.
Recall procedure to verify deadlines, timezone, eligibility region, and official rules.
Recall failure memory about not recommending excluded-region events.
Recall creates a trace id with selected memories.
A tight token budget causes at least one memory to be ignored by context-pack building.
Mock provider extracts a pending candidate memory from a user correction.
Candidate preference conflicts with older prize-money prioritization.
Invalidating an outdated memory moves it out of active recall.
